label: Residual Risk Calculation (deterministic)
description: Codifies the deterministic residual calculation rule used by the Risk Atlas: residual = inherent − reduction(rollup), clamped to [1, 5], where Strong=-2, Adequate=-1, Weak=0, Absent=0. The rollup is the WORST strength across all controls touching the path's vulnerabilities. The number is computed by atlas-residual-calculator.ts; the LLM produces only the rationale around it.
